caveats: Official municipal/tourism pages state 13 km; Naturkartan says 13.6 km and computes to 13.611 km; OSM computes around 13.657 km; AllTrails reports 13.8 km; Wikiloc user track is about 14.44 km.

Västsverige/Härryda says Etapp 1 starts at Hindås station, but also says Sjuhäradsleden begins at Hindåsgården. Official map and GPX support a Hindås station stage start with route passing Hindåsgården.
Official section label says Hestrafors IF, OSM relation says to=Brandshed, and the Naturkartan/OSM route endpoint is about 350-400 m south of Borås's Hestrafors IF/Bollevi coordinate.
Borås describes the trail generally as well signposted, while Naturkartan warns the whole trail is not fully quality-assured and field reports include both good-marking and weak-marking experiences.
Official descriptions emphasize forest, small paths and forest roads. Recent AllTrails reviews complain that much of the stage is asphalt/gravel/transport-like.

Official pages/map legend show access symbols, but no official source confirms stage-specific toilet, shelter or water facilities on Etapp 1. OSM/Naturkartan third-party objects identify several nearby candidates.
Klippan naturreservat is near the Hindås trail network and has strict rules, but exact overlap with Etapp 1 GPX was not confirmed.
A 2025 AllTrails review reports the first part was closed due to ski tracks. Hindås SK has active ski operations, but no official walking-route winter closure notice for Etapp 1 was found.
Official Sjuhäradsleden order and Naturkartan GPX are Hindås to Hestrafors IF; E1 Hiking Europe presents the same geometry in reverse as Hestrafors IF to Hindås.

Official sources say good normal-condition surface, while Naturkartan warns of trail-wide signage/passability issues and 2025 user reports mention slippery boardwalks, overgrowth/bugs and substantial gravel-road character.
No official potable water source was found, while shelter-map water information is unknown quality.
